reuse.why: Fintegra linking goes through the existing shared linkBankSyncAccount and findOrCreateBank, and the server URL follows the existing server-config pattern; the takeover re-writes unlinkAccount's field reset instead of sharing it.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is another near-copy of the Akahu/Pluggy download functions, the eight-field unlink update is copied from unlinkAccount, and the guard call is pasted into six provider wrappers.

placement.why: The provider code sits in the right modules (sync.ts, app.ts, server-config), but the link-time rules are called from each provider wrapper instead of the shared link step, and the guard named ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked also performs the unlink mutation.

scope.why: Covers the four steps; widening DbAccount.account_sync_source to all providers is related but goes beyond what Fintegra needs.

maintainability.why: Central guard for both refusal rules is good, but a check-named function that mutates under a boolean, a copy of the unlink reset that can drift from unlinkAccount, and per-provider guard calls a new provider must remember make it harder to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: accounts/app.ts ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked clears the old account with its own db.updateAccount instead of a reset shared with unlinkAccount (the comment explains avoiding the GoCardless requisition removal, but no shared piece was extracted).

disguised_duplication.where: accounts/sync.ts downloadFintegraTransactions is the Akahu/Pluggy download body with renamed locals and a compacted result object rather than a shared download helper.

abstraction_drift.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked (created in step 1) gains a replaceExistingLink parameter and a branch that turns the refusal into an in-place unlink; every provider link function, including Fintegra, calls it.
